newsitem.title: USA: Aaron Rents stake cut by Gabelli group.
newsitem.headline: Aaron Rents stake cut by Gabelli group.

text.p: A group led by New York investment manager Mario Gabelli said Friday it cuts its stake in Aaron Rents Inc to 468,500 Class A common shares or, 12.36 percent of the company from 13.70 percent previously held.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest actions include the sale of 12,800 Class A common shares between October 28 and December 20 at prices ranging from $13.1250 to $15.25 per share.
Aaron Rents, of Atlanta, Ga., manufactures, rents and sells residential and office furniture and other merchandise.
